name: mercury-cli-sdk
description: Mercury CLI clients for TypeScript: typed run streams, hosted sessions and zero-cost fixtures.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';const docs={validate:'Check a value against one of the generated JSON Schemas and return every issue found.',Issue:'One validation failure: the JSON path and what was wrong there.',UnknownRow:'A row whose type this package does not know; raw keeps the whole row and the envelope fields are copied beside it.',StreamRow:'Any known output or partial Row, or an UnknownRow for forward-compatible types.',RowReadFailure:'Why a line or value could not be parsed as a known row.',RowRead:'The reading of one row: row when ok, otherwise reason (and issues for an invalid known type).',InputRowRead:'The reading of one input row: row when ok, otherwise reason and issues.',isRowType:'True when type is a known output or partial row type.',isInputRowType:'True when type is a known input row type.',rowOf:'Read a decoded row object; an unfamiliar type becomes an UnknownRow rather than a failure.',parseRow:'Read one stdout line as a row.',inputRowOf:'Read an input row (prompt, shell or note) with the wire non-empty rules applied.',isOutcome:'True when the row is an OutcomeRow.',isSessionRow:'True when the row is a SessionRow.',turnOpened:'True when the row is a TurnRow with state started.',turnWaiting:'True when the row is a TurnRow with state waiting.',mainThreadStep:'True when the row is a main-thread StepRow.',isMainThread:'True for a row of the main conversation; a subagent rows carry parent_call_id.',outcomeFailed:'True when the OutcomeRow status is not completed.',outcomeErrorText:'The error message of an OutcomeRow, if present.',isRetryableOutcome:'True when a failed OutcomeRow has a transient error class (api, network or rate_limit).',assertCompleted:'Return the OutcomeRow when status is completed, or throw MercuryError.',RunExit:'How the mercury process ended: its exit code or the signal that ended it, and everything it wrote to stderr.',Door:'Which CLI door the process ran (run or runner).',MercuryError:'The base of every error the package raises; RPC errors carry the runner code and data.',MercuryRefusal:'Mercury refused the request: a refused outcome row (outcome set) or an RPC refusal (outcome is null).',MercuryUsageError:'The command line was refused (exit 2) before any row or answer; the message is the CLI first stderr line.',MercuryExitError:'The process ended before a run produced its outcome row or before a session was closed; the last stderr line is quoted.',MercurySpawnError:'The mercury process could not be started: no such executable, or no such working directory.',MercuryWireError:'A line on the wire was not a row or message the package knows; line, reason and issues say what was wrong.',ConfigLayer:'A configuration layer accepted by configLayers (user, project or local).',RunOptions:'Everything run() and connect() accept; each field is one mercury run option.',RunArgv:'The resolved executable and argument list produced by argvOf().',argvOf:'The exact command line run() would start for these options.',interruptedOutcome:'The outcome row of a turn the package interrupted when the child ended by the signal before writing its own.',MercuryRun:'One mercury run process: an async iterator of its rows, with outcome, session and exit awaitable.',run:'Start mercury run for a prompt (or input: rows for streamed input) and return its handle once the process has started.',RequestContext:'Handed to every host handler: the request id and an AbortSignal aborted when the runner cancels the ask.',HostHandlers:'Runner-to-host JSON-RPC request callbacks keyed by method name.',PermissionHandler:'Host callback for permission/request asks.',ElicitationHandler:'Host callback for elicitation/request asks.',ReadTextFileHandler:'Host callback for fs/read_text_file requests.',WriteTextFileHandler:'Host callback for fs/write_text_file requests.',ConnectOptions:'Everything connect() and prewarm() accept: RunOptions fields plus host handlers, capabilities, checkpoints and warm.',RequestOptions:'Per-request signal and deadlineMs override for session.request().',PromptOptions:'Per-turn signal, timeoutMs, interruptOnAbort and schema options for session.prompt().',MercurySession:'One mercury runner process hosted over JSON-RPC: prompts go in, rows stream out, asks are answered by your handlers.',connect:'Start mercury runner and complete initialize, asking for file checkpoints unless checkpoints: false.',prewarm:'connect({ warm: true }): an unclaimed runner to claim before prompting.',AgentDefinition:'An inline agent for agentDefs: the same keys as an agent definition file.',defineAgent:'Check an inline agent definition has a description and a prompt and return a copy.',ToolResult:'What an inline tool returns when it needs more than a string: MCP text content and an optional error flag.',ToolContext:'Context passed to an inline tool execute callback, carrying its cancellation AbortSignal.',ToolDefinition:'An inline tool: its MCP name, description, JSON Schema for the input, and the function that runs it.',defineTool:'Build a ToolDefinition; execute may be sync or async and return a string or a ToolResult.',serveTools:'Serve inline tools over bearer-authenticated loopback MCP HTTP; the event loop must keep running while tools execute.',ToolServer:'A loopback MCP server for inline tools; pass mcp to run({ mcp: [...] }) and close() it when done.',textBlock:'Build a text InputBlock for a prompt.',imageBlock:'Build an image InputBlock from base64 text, bytes, or { path }.',allowPermission:'Build an allow PermissionRequestResult with optional updated input or permission rules.',denyPermission:'Build a deny PermissionRequestResult with an optional refusal message and interrupt flag.',VERSION:'The mercury-cli-sdk package version.',StructuredSchema:'A JSON Schema paired with a decoder that transforms validated structured output into T.',structuredSchema:'Pair a JSON Schema with a decoder so run() and prompt() return OutcomeRow<T>.',OutputSchema:'A JSON Schema object, JSON string, file path, or StructuredSchema<T> descriptor.',schemaObject:'Resolve an OutputSchema into its raw JsonSchema object.',MercurySchemaError:'Structured output did not match its schema (outcome is the raw row), or the CLI refused a schema that is not a JSON Schema (outcome is null).',schemaRefusal:'The CLI -32602 answer to a schema that is not a JSON Schema, as a MercurySchemaError; undefined for any other error.',validateOutcome:'Validate a completed outcome structured output against schema and decode it when given a StructuredSchema.',FixtureMessage:'A raw JSON-RPC message or row object in a fixture recording.',FixtureReply:'One recorded answer to a host request: its result or error, with messages sent before and after it.',Fixture:'A recording to replay: run-door rows (after inputCount stdin rows), and runner-door methods and answers.',startFixtureServer:'Replay recorded rows and RPC responses on loopback, without a model or CLI.',fixtureSessionRow:'Build a valid fixture SessionRow with optional field overrides.',fixtureOutcomeRow:'Build a valid fixture OutcomeRow with optional field overrides.',fixtureTurn:'Build a correlated fixture [TurnRow, OutcomeRow] pair.'};const dir=path.resolve(process.argv[1]??'dist');const lead='/'+'** ';const nl=String.fromCharCode(10);const prefixes=['export declare function ','export declare const ','export declare class ','export interface ','export type '];for(const file of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.d.ts'))){const p=path.join(dir,file);const text=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(text.includes(lead))continue;const lines=text.split(nl).flatMap(line=>{if(file==='index.d.ts'&&(line.startsWith('export {')||line.startsWith('export type {'))){const t=line.startsWith('export type ');const open=line.indexOf('{');const close=line.indexOf('}');const tail=line.slice(close+1);return line.slice(open+1,close).split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s=>{const name=s.startsWith('type ')?s.slice(5).trim():s;const spec=t&&!s.startsWith('type ')?'type '+s:s;return(docs[name]?lead+docs[name]+' */'+nl:'')+'export { '+spec+' }'+tail;});}const hit=prefixes.find(pr=>line.startsWith(pr));if(!hit)return[line];const name=line.slice(hit.length).split(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/)[0];return docs[name]?[lead+docs[name]+' */',line]:[line];});fs.writeFileSync(p,lines.join(nl));}"
